description: Rework the RSVP Form to be driven by the Guest List via the gate session. On load, fetch the party by party_id (re-reading plus_one_allowed live) and pre-fill who the Guest is. One submitter sets attending plus dietary for each listed party member, and a Plus-one section appears only when a party member is plus_one_allowed. Submission fans out to one rsvps row per answered member plus one row for a named Plus-one, each stamped party_id and guest_id; the rsvps tab keeps its existing columns and appends party_id and guest_id, with is_plus_one derived (empty guest_id + present party_id). Partial answers and re-submits are tolerated (append-only). Validation is HITL: deploy and have the couple test the couple-for-both and solo-with-+1 flows live.
title: Guest-list-driven RSVP with per-person fan-out
acceptance_criteria: The form pre-fills the matched Guest and loads co-members by party_id
One submitter can set attending and dietary for each listed member; a couple-for-both writes one row per member
A Plus-one section shows only when a party member is plus_one_allowed; a named Plus-one is written as its own row
Every appended row is stamped party_id and the listed member's guest_id (empty for a Plus-one row)
Partial answers leave unanswered members not-replied; a re-submit appends without error
RSVP fan-out is unit-tested: couple-for-both, solo-with-named-+1, partial answer, and attending=no, asserting the stamped keys
Deployed and confirmed by the couple across the couple and solo-+1 flows
